items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: there wasn't a chance of catching Louis Armstrong because he had a style, you know, and that was it.

ctx.x: They're not trying to put too many notes.

Yeah, you know, instead of holding a note where it's supposed to be a whole note, they'd break that note up in the eighths, you know, and you didn't call it amplifiers, you know, and all that, come back. They kept kind of moderating with it. During the time, Wooden Joe and you heard Buddy P.T. and this guy died on Conti Street, Kid Ranney, good trumpet players in them days. Kid Ranney, they was good trumpet players. Now, Sidney and them coming along, well, they're trying to, they couldn't, they couldn't, they…
Did you ever play with any of those bands like Buddy Petit or Rene?
